blocks.title: Repair the join
blocks.problem: $f(x)=2x+k$ for $x<3$ and $f(x)=x^2$ for $x\ge3$. Find $k$ for continuity.

steps.title: Compute both sides
steps.md: The left limit is $6+k$. The right limit and $f(3)$ both equal $9$.
steps.why: Use the branch valid on each side.

steps.title: Equate
steps.why: Continuity requires equality with the assigned value.

blocks.title: Show a root exists
blocks.problem: Show $x^3+x-7=0$ has a solution between 1 and 2.
blocks.answer: At least one root lies in $(1,2)$.

steps.title: Check continuity
steps.why: The IVT needs continuity on the whole interval.

steps.title: Evaluate endpoints
steps.why: Zero lies strictly between the endpoint outputs.
